text: Since 311 interacts with over 300,000 Toronto residents every year and provides a wide range of vital City Services, it is important that there be an annual presentation by 311 officials to City Council in order to better inform Members of Council and the residents of Toronto about the vital service and operation of this key City link with the people of Toronto.

City Council on September 30, October 1 and 2, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the Director, 311 Toronto to submit an annual update report to the General Government and Licensing Committee outlining important service issues and trends. 2. City Council direct the Director, 311 Toronto to send a quarterly Briefing Note to all City Councillors summarizing quarterly trends and findings from a 311 perspective.
